        static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;

                            }

                            dp[i][h][0] = (dp[i - 1][h - 1][1] + 1) % MOD;
                            dp[i][h][1] = dp[i - 1][h - 1][0];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            out.println(dp[n][0][0]);
        }
    }

        public StringTokenizer tokenizer;

                }

        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }
